{{Quote|That is why I have placed you here, on Khar Delba, and your brother... elsewhere. I have two identical fortresses, my stronghold and this decoy. The Sith executioners can never find you both&mdash;one of you will always be safe.|Naga Sadow, to [[Jori Daragon]]|<ref name="Golden Age 4" />}}
The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] had a decoy '''citadel''' built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khar Delba]]. The citadel was of the exact same design as that of Sadow's [[Naga Sadow's Khar Shian citadel|citadel]] on [[Khar Shian]], which served as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] true base of operations.<ref name="Golden Age 4" />

It was [[Battle of Khar Delba|attacked]] by [[Ludo Kressh's faction|forces loyal to the opposing claimant]] to the title [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Ludo Kressh]], in a struggle for power over the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Golden Age 4" />
